Terms.title: Amategeko agenga ikoreshwa n’ubuzima bwite
Terms.intro: Uru rupapuro rusobanura, mu magambo yumvikana, uburyo AKIBA ikora, icyo yanditse n’icyo ushobora gusaba.

about.title: Hafi AKIBA
points: AKIBA yerekana imyenda yakozwe n’abadozi bemewe muri Kigali, hamwe n’inkuru iri inyuma ya buri imwe.
Ni umushinga w’ubushakashatsi wa Mission Capstone wakozwe na Kenneth Chirchir.

AKIBA ni imurikagurisha, si iduka. Nta kwishyura cyangwa komisiyo bisaba. Abaguzi n’abadozi bemeranya ku giciro cyabigenewe, kandi abaguzi bishyura umudozi mu buryo butaziguye, bakoresheje MoMo cyangwa amafaranga.

buyers.title: Gukoresha AKIBA nk’umuguzi
points: Ntabwo ukeneye konti.
Imyenda n’abadozi ubitse muri iyi porogaramu yo gushakisha kuri telefoni yawe gusa. Gukuraho porogaramu yo gushakisha bikuraho.

AKIBA ibarura uburyo amapaji yayo akoreshwa: inkuru zifungurwa n’igihe zimara, kubika, gukanda kuri Shaka amabwiriza cyangwa Hamagara, no gusaba. Izi nyandiko zikoresha nimero isanzwe ibitswe muri cookie, ntabwo ari izina ryawe cyangwa nimero ya terefone.

tailors.title: Gukoresha AKIBA nk’umudozi
points: Iyandikishe ukoresheje nimero yawe ya telefoni igendanwa yo mu Rwanda hamwe n’imibare 5 ya PIN Bika ibanga ryawe PIN. Nta muntu n’umwe kuri AKIBA uzigera arisaba.
Iduka ryawe ritangira gukoreshwa ku mugaragaro gusa nyuma yuko AKIBA imaze gusuzuma amakuru yawe n’ishyirahamwe ry’abadozi, kandi buri mwenda wose ubanza gusuzumwa mbere yuko abaguzi bawubona.
Amafoto n’inkuru usohora ni ibyawe bwite. Iyo ubishyize ahagaragara, uba wemereye AKIBA kubyerekana ku rubuga mu gihe cy’ubushakashatsi.
Shyira gusa imyenda wikoreye ubwawe, ifite ibisobanuro nyabyo n’ibiciro. AKIBA ishobora guhisha imyenda cyangwa guhagarika iduka rirenze kuri aya mategeko.
Aderesi y’iduka ryawe yerekwa abaguzi kugira ngo bashobore kukubona. Ntukigere winjiza aderesi yawe yo mu rugo.
Ushobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba umwenda uwo ari wo wose, no gusiba konti yawe yose, igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Profile.

requests.title: Ibyifuzo na nimero za terefone
points: Iyo usabye umwenda, izina ryawe, nimero ya terefone n’ibisobanuro birambuye bijya kuri uwo muntu udoda imyenda gusa, mu gasanduku ke AKIBA no kuri SMS.
Umaze kohereza ubusabe, ubona nimero ya terefone y’umudozi kugira ngo ubashe kumuhamagara.
Nta wundi muntu ushobora gusoma ibyifuzo, harimo n’umushakashatsi AKIBA Ubushakashatsi bubara gusa umubare w’ibyifuzo byoherejwe.
Ubutumwa SMS bwoherejwe binyuze muri Africa’s Talking.

research.title: Ubushakashatsi
points: AKIBA ni igice cy’inyigo y’uburyo inkuru zifasha abakiri bato guha agaciro abadozi bo mu gace batuyemo. Kwitabira iyi nyigo ni ubushake kandi bisaba ko ubyemera.
Iyo witabiriye, ubona umurongo wihariye uri kumwe n’umubare w’abayitabiriye. Iyo kode ihuza ikoreshwa ryawe rya AKIBA n’ibibazo byawe, nta zina ryawe.
Mu bisubizo, amazina y’abantu asimbuzwa kode. Amakuru y’ubushakashatsi arasiba iyo ubushakashatsi burangiye.
Ushobora guhagarika kwitabira igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, nta mpamvu utanze.

cookies.title: Kuki
points: akiba_visitor: nimero idasanzwe y’inyandiko z’ikoreshwa, ibikwa mu gihe cy’umwaka.
akiba_participant: kode yawe y’umufatanyabikorwa, gusa iyo wafunguye umurongo wo kwiga ku giti cyawe, ikabikwa mu gihe cy’umwaka.
Injira kuri cookies z’abadozi n’abashakashatsi, zibikwa kugeza usohotse, cyangwa kugeza ku mwaka umwe niba ushyize akamenyetso kuri Remember me.
Kuki ngufi, zibikwa iminota 30, zibuka kwiyandikisha, gusubiza PIN cyangwa ubusabe wamaze kohereza.
AKIBA nta kwamamaza cyangwa gukurikirana cookies ziturutse ku zindi sosiyete.

storage.title: Aho amakuru abikwa
points: Ububiko bw’amakuru n’iyandikwa biyoborwa na Supabase, amafoto abikwa na Cloudinary, naho urubuga rukorera kuri Vercel. Babika amakuru kuri AKIBA kandi ntibayakoresha mu kindi kintu icyo ari cyo cyose.
Amakuru yawe asangizwa gusa umudozi wakira icyifuzo cyawe.

rights.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
points: Abadozi: jya kuri Profile, hanyuma usibe konti. Iduka ryawe, imyenda, amafoto, inkuru, ubusabe bwawe n’inyandiko z’imikoreshereze bihita bisibangana.
Abaguzi n’abitabiriye ubushakashatsi: hamagara AKIBA kugira ngo ibyifuzo byawe cyangwa amakuru yawe y’ubushakashatsi asibwe, cyangwa uhagarike kwitabira.
Umuntu wese ashobora kubaza amakuru AKIBA amufiteho, maze agakosorwa.

requests.question: Ese ubusabe bw’abaguzi bukora bute?
requests.answer: Iyo umuguzi asabye imwe mu myenda yawe, igaragara mu nyandiko zisaba kandi ubona SMS iriho amazina ye na nimero ye ya terefone. Muhamagare kugira ngo mwemeranye ingano, igiciro n’uburyo ikoreshwa.

payments.question: Ese AKIBA ikora uburyo bwo kwishyura?
payments.answer: Nomero AKIBA nta mafaranga yishyurwa kandi nta komisiyo. Umuguzi akwishyura ako kanya, akoresheje MoMo cyangwa amafaranga.
